heading: Budget Errors Prompt a Second Public Hearing
summary: City staff said the published 2027 budget draft misstated year-to-year changes and staffing counts. They said the underlying budget figures were accurate and the proposal still projected an $8 decrease in city taxes for the average home. Residents questioned the review process, and officials announced a second public hearing for November 17.

heading: Committee Backs Crossing Guards Through the School Year
summary: The committee voted 7–0 to add $35,000 to the proposed police budget to maintain existing crossing guard coverage through June 5, 2027. A $70,000 proposal to extend coverage through the end of 2027 failed 2–5. Alders discussed student safety and how the city and school district might share responsibility after June.

heading: Committee Splits Proposed Nonprofit Funding
source: Committee of the Whole video · 0:41:04–0:44:48 and 2:32:41–2:47:05
summary: The committee voted 5–2 to split a $260,000 budget allocation between a $130,000 reserve for Colonial Club's emergency request and a $130,000 pool for nonprofit applicants. The emergency request still required Common Council approval at the time. Earlier, Sunshine Place said it had skipped applying after being told funding would be unavailable.

heading: Wisconsin Highlights Lead Testing at Child Care Centers
summary: The Department of Health Services reported that its lead-in-water initiative had reached 650 child care centers. The announcement also highlighted statewide efforts to improve childhood blood lead testing. The agency released the update during National Lead Poisoning Prevention Week.
